turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi. Every time I try to search for something, no results are showing up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let's try a couple solutions to that. Can you try logging out of your account and then logging back in?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I have done that, it didn't work...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you try clearing the cookies in your browser?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you tell me how to do that?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yep, if you go into your settings option in the browser and select "More Details", you should see it

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks, that seemed to work! I can see the results now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Awesome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
